about_the_game:
Omnivael: Chronicles of the Realm

(The Open-Ended, Continent-Spanning High-Fantasy Epic)

Omnivael: Chronicles of the Realm is a monumental open-world RPG, delivered one continent at a time to ensure unparalleled scale, mechanical depth, and complete non-linear player freedom.

You are chosen by prophecy to bring balance to a world consumed by rising tensions between kingdoms and dark forces. Forge your own legend in a realm where every choice carries generational weight.

A Proven Foundation: Scaled-Up Mechanics

The ambitious scope of Chronicles of the Realm is built upon battle-tested systems. Every core mechanic, from combat to crafting, is a direct, scaled-up implementation of the systems perfected in our ongoing Early Access title, Wayfarer's Life: Eastern Mystria.

* Open-Ended Destiny: The story unfolds in three grand acts—The Awakening, Unraveling the Mysteries, and The Confrontation—but your path is entirely your own. Your choices during character interactions can alter story outcomes and shift alliances across the realm.

* Generational Impact: Navigate the complex political structures of Omnivael, where your actions influence the balance of power. Just as player choices can establish new kingdoms on the Eastmarch frontier, your decisions here will determine the fate of entire continents.

Explore a World of Continents

Uncover the secrets and lore of Omnivael, a vast world of high fantasy, magic, and swords and sorcery.

* Vast Open World: Explore multiple distinct biomes and regions, including:

* Valtoria: The primary human kingdom, known for its military strength.

* Stonehearth Hold: Dwarven cities nestled deep within the mountains, rich in craftsmanship.

* Eryndor: The home of the high elves, an ethereal, magical region.

* Shadowfang Territory: Dangerous lands occupied by orc tribes and dark creatures.

* Environmental Storytelling: Uncover the history of the world through visual cues like ruins, ancient markings, and hidden dungeons scattered across the landscape.

Deep, Action-Oriented Systems

The refined and scaled mechanics ensure a detailed and responsive RPG experience:

* Real-Time Action Combat: Engage in visceral, real-time combat featuring melee weapons, ranged options, and magical abilities. Unlock powerful combos and master varied weaponry like swords, axes, bows, and staffs.

* Deep Magic System: Magic is divided into schools (e.g., elemental, healing, illusion). Spells utilize lifelike particle effects and fluid animations to enhance immersion.

* Progression & Customization: Create a customizable avatar and gain experience through combat and story-driven, side, and procedural quests. Customize your build using dedicated Skill Trees for warriors, mages, and rogues.

* Robust World Systems: Manage resources with a slot-based Inventory System and a comprehensive Crafting system for weapons, potions, and enchanted items. The Dynamic Day/Night Cycle impacts gameplay, quest availability, and enemy behavior across the entire map.

Technical Specifications

* Engine: Unity 6.2

* Visual Style: Stylized Textures applied to intricate environments and detailed character designs, creating a visually vibrant high-fantasy world.

Omnivael: Chronicles of the Realm is a generational commitment to a living, reactive fantasy world. We invite you to follow the development and step into a realm where the story is perpetually being written across its continents.
